verdict.rationale: Baseten has dedicated first-party docs for connecting coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Pi) via Baseten Switch, plus a documented MCP server/skill for agent workspace management, and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints enabling framework integrations like LangChain. This is corroborated by a live probe confirming the MCP endpoint responds correctly. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the coding-agent connection flow beyond docs/probes.
